predictions.match: Zalgiris Kaunas v LDLC ASVEL Villeurbanne
predictions.text: Zalgiris Kaunas taking a 6.5-point start against LDLC ASVEL Villeurbanne is the play in this Friday night round seven tie. Both clubs reach round seven sitting on identical 2-4 records, so the separator is the scoring balance rather than the win column: Kaunas have been outscored by 27 points over six rounds, 490 for and 517 against, whereas Villeurbanne's hole is 45 points, 527 for and 572 against. Kaunas are therefore the tighter of the two units and are giving up nothing like ASVEL's margin, and with six and a half points in hand they only need to avoid a seven-point collapse. Back Zalgiris plus 6.5 to cover, winning outright or losing by six or fewer.
